title: event definitions
description: Event envelopes restricted by kind and the plaintext bodies of every event kind (03-api.md section 10, 04-crypto.md section 4.3). The envelope and header themselves are common.json#/$defs/event.

ct.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext, at most 256 KiB decoded (04-crypto.md E8)

ct_terminal.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of a terminal chunk, at most 64 KiB decoded (04-crypto.md E8)

header_device.description: event header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.3); the device-authored kinds except session.terminal, all workgroup-scoped (scope wg, wg set)

event_other.description: event of any kind except session.terminal

event_terminal.description: event of kind session.terminal (at most 64 KiB ciphertext)

header_browser_action.description: event header of kind browser.action (a watched kind, 13-work-vm.md section 13.6)

event_browser_action.description: event of kind browser.action (the stream frame browser_action)

event_device.description: event of a device-authored kind (04-crypto.md section 4.3): the outbox item event

name.description: display name (UTF-8 body JSON, non-ASCII allowed)
display name (UTF-8 body JSON, non-ASCII allowed)

body_member_name.description: A name an admin gives to a member or to the person of an invitation (header ref = user ID or invite_id); a member's own member.profile always ranks first (ADR-073).

items.description: branch name or glob pattern with *

merge_criteria.description: formal criteria of github.merge (KOR-51, ADR-094 section 5); absent or all zero/false: only GitHub's own rules apply

passed_verdicts.description: passed review.verdict operations on exactly the head needed, from distinct sessions other than the merging one with profile verdict_profile (0: none)

verdict_profile.description: the profile the verdict sessions must have had (default review)

checks_green.description: the check runs and statuses of the head must all have succeeded

github_approvals.description: approving GitHub reviews on exactly the head by distinct accounts needed (0: none)

separate_duties.description: a session that made or pushed a commit of the pull request may neither give a verdict on its head nor merge it, and its verdicts never count (KOR-51, ADR-094 section 6); default false

body_session_status.description: status of a session (03-api.md section 10): an error, a state, or an operation the platform holds until the task owner acts (KOR-25)

details.description: flat non-confidential metadata: printable ASCII text up to 256 characters, integers, booleans, null
flat non-confidential metadata: printable ASCII text up to 256 characters, integers, booleans, null

oneOf.description: an operation of the session waits for the person who gave the instruction (for_user; absent from runners before HOT-14: the task owner); the runner checks it again when that person connects GitHub (and, for github_access, periodically) or the workgroup settings change and rejects it at until. Only platform-checked values, never text of the session

waiting_for.description: github_connection: the person who gave the instruction has no usable GitHub connection; github_access: that person's connection does not reach the repository (KOR-65), next names the one step that fixes it

for_user.description: the acting user: the person whose instruction requested the operation and whose own GitHub connection it will use (HOT-14); only this person is asked to connect

body_operation_params.description: type and parameters of an operation (03-api.md section 10); params per ops/<type>.params.json

body_operation_result.description: final outcome of an operation (03-api.md section 10)

connection_of.description: for a type that needs a personal connection (GitHub): the person who gave the instruction, the only one whose own connection its checks and execution used or could use (HOT-14); absent otherwise and when nobody could be named

for a type that needs a personal connection (GitHub): the person who gave the instruction, the only one whose own connection its checks and execution used or could use (HOT-14); absent otherwise and when nobody could be named

body_platform_read.description: a read through the session platform API (03-api.md section 10): tool, arguments, result count

body_workvm_run.description: a job of a work VM, written when it starts and when it ends (13-work-vm.md section 8)

body_workvm_state.description: a work VM is starting (implicit request), was created, stopped (paused session) or deleted, with its runtime (13-work-vm.md section 8, KONZEPT idea 46)

body_test_run.description: a test run of the operation test.run, written when it starts and when it ends (13-work-vm.md section 12, ADR-080)

body_browser_action.description: one tool call of a platform browser session with the picture after it (13-work-vm.md section 13.5, ADR-085); text of a password field is ••••

anyOf.description: the viewport after the action: JPEG, at most 960 px wide and 100 KiB decoded

body_browser_state.description: the lifecycle of a platform browser session: starting (before the VM), open, restarted (fresh VM after a failure, reason vm_lost or restart), closed with its reason (13-work-vm.md section 13.5, ADR-085)

implicit.description: opened by a browser tool call without browser.open (operation_id null)

body_session_error.description: an error the guest reported for the session (KOR-40, ADR-064 section 5): the code of the closed list of the guest journal's guest.error record (contracts/guest/journal/record.json), never free text

github_next_step.description: github_access (KOR-65): the one step that gives the connection access to the repository. connect: connect GitHub again with the device flow that reaches every repository of the account; install_app: install the GitHub App for the owner (url); approve_app: request or grant the organisation's approval of the OAuth App (url); authorize_sso: authorise the token for the organisation's SAML single sign-on (url); new_token: create a token that reaches the owner (url, pre-filled) and store it; check_access: the account itself has no access - open the repository at GitHub (url) and ask its owner, or connect another account. url is built by the runner from its configured GitHub web URL and checked values only

owner.description: the owner of the repository (account or organisation)

url.description: https URL on the GitHub web host, or http on the loopback host (hermetic doubles)

body_task_agent_name.description: the name a person gives the main agent of a task (ADR-095 section 2); null = back to the automatic name

body_support_info.description: The names a support person needs to read a released workgroup without the org key (ADR-096 section 4): the organization, the workgroup and the readers of the workgroup by user ID; written by the releasing client, the newest counts.
